Use venv /root/qv (/root/qv/bin/python). Real Quotex login is blocked from this pod (Cloudflare) — only the offline sim is possible. rca of the issue: N/A — user-reported bug ('199 historical candles are not being fetched, candles after those must be tick-built') is not reproducible offline: the collector correctly loads exactly 199 candles strictly older than collector.started_at for every (market, period) pair, then builds subsequent candles from ticks. The pipeline logic is verified correct. If the bug still manifests on the user's VPS it is almost certainly a real-broker issue (history/load reply shape, latency > HISTORY_TIMEOUT_S=15s, or the fallback path). Recommend: on VPS, enable DEBUG logging for 'live-collector', check 'history %s/%ss: %d candles' log lines to see if any stream returns < 199 (which would indicate the real broker's history/load reply is shaped differently or slow).
